metrics.basis: len(classes) of docs/ci-triage-table.json (the standing CI failing-case classification table, one class per marker family)
count of tests/fixtures/ci_triage_*.json (the canned failure-log fixture vectors tools/ci_triage.py --selftest consumes; the fixture set is the regression thickness)
len(rows) of tools/taxonomy.json (the vacgen statement taxonomy the recognition face classifies against)
len(patterns) of wash/cure_pack.json (the wash cure pattern pack)
the roster count word of `mcp_server.py --selftest` (TOOL_SPECS length, the frozen SELFTEST_ROSTER_COUNT vector)
the [SUMMARY] pass field of tests/test_tool_selftests.py (tool --selftest faces green under the per-tool 120s cap; a red or vanished face drops this reading and trips the gate)
the repair_action_rate token of `learning_feedback.py` (repaired / (repaired + escalated + watch_only + unrecorded) over the round repair ledger)
the ready-classes count of `b_gate_audit.py` (classes holding threshold instances and rounds; the B-level admission gate's ignition gauge)
the agreement_rate token of `learning_feedback.py` (predicted-confidence × measured-rc pairing over the calibration ledger); zero entries reads null = unmeasured, never 0 (0 entries at this window)
